description: This enhanced N-API impl field-access extraction. Adds three detections that the callee-targets pass's recursive extractor missed: (1) decimal-offset field accesses (Ghidra prints small offsets without 0x prefix); (2) param_1 alias tracking (prologue copies like `iVar1 = param_1;` followed by `*(int *)(iVar1 + 0xc)` reads); (3) pure vtable-trampoline detection (impls whose body is `(**(code **)(*param_1 + 0xN))()` are recorded with their delegation slot number). Output schema matches control_class_napi_field_access_recursive.json with two added fields: directVtableSlots and deepVtableSlots.
